summary: MSVC streambuf get-pointer increment (gninc). Pre-decrements the remaining-count dword pointed to by this+0x2C, then fetches the current byte through the read pointer stored at this+0x1C and post-increments that pointer. Advances the buffer read position by one byte and returns the byte read. Called by StdBasicStreambufUflow (00598cdc) and sub_5990AE (005990ae).

local_names.this: MSVC-style streambuf object holding the read position and remaining count
local_names.v1: read pointer loaded from this+0x1C, dereferenced and incremented

operations.description: Pre-decrements the remaining-count dword reached through the pointer stored at this+0x2C: --**(this+0x2C)
Loads the read pointer v1 from this+0x1C, returns the current byte *v1, then increments the pointer: return (*v1)++
Returns the byte at the read position before the pointer advanced (the character fetched)
Invoked by StdBasicStreambufUflow (00598cdc) and sub_5990AE (005990ae) as the streambuf get-pointer advance

unresolved: The concrete layout of the streambuf (read pointer at this+0x1C, remaining-count pointer at this+0x2C) is inferred from the MSVC streambuf idiom; the owning class is unknown
